import sys
import tkinter as tk


def check_sqlite():
    import sqlite3
    db = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        db.execute("create table probe (value integer)")
        db.execute("insert into probe values (1)")
        assert db.execute("select value from probe").fetchone() == (1,)
    finally:
        db.close()


def check_tls():
    import ssl
    import truststore
    context = truststore.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT)
    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_REQUIRED


def check_timezone():
    import tzdata
    from datetime import datetime
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    zone = ZoneInfo("America/Chicago")
    assert datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=zone).utcoffset().total_seconds() == -21600
    assert datetime(2026, 7, 15, tzinfo=zone).utcoffset().total_seconds() == -18000


def check_requests():
    import requests
    request = requests.Request("GET", "https://example.invalid/").prepare()
    assert request.method == "GET"


def check_selenium():
    from selenium.webdriver.edge.options import Options
    from selenium.webdriver.edge.service import Service
    assert Options().to_capabilities()["browserName"] == "MicrosoftEdge"
    assert callable(Service)


def check_com():
    import pythoncom
    import win32com.client
    pythoncom.CoInitialize()
    try:
        assert callable(win32com.client.GetActiveObject)
    finally:
        pythoncom.CoUninitialize()


def run_checks():
    checks = [
        ("SQLite memory database", check_sqlite),
        ("TLS / truststore", check_tls),
        ("Central timezone / tzdata", check_timezone),
        ("Requests (no connection)", check_requests),
        ("Selenium (no browser)", check_selenium),
        ("Windows COM (no Outlook access)", check_com),
    ]
    results = []
    for name, check in checks:
        try:
            check()
        except Exception as exc:
            results.append(f"FAIL  {name}: {type(exc).__name__}")
        else:
            results.append(f"PASS  {name}")
    return results


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("Packaged dependency probe")
    root.resizable(False, False)
    results = run_checks()
    mode = "EXE" if getattr(sys, "frozen", False) else "Python script"
    text = "Mode: " + mode + "\nPASS  Tkinter window\n" + "\n".join(results)
    text += "\n\nNo network requests, saved credentials, or email used."
    tk.Label(root, text=text, justify="left", padx=24, pady=20).pack()
    tk.Button(root, text="Close", command=root.destroy).pack(pady=(0, 16))
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
